# Evaluation and Testing {#sec-evaluation-testing}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_How can an agentic system be tested when behavior is stateful, stochastic, and environment dependent?_

## Planned Coverage

- Evaluation units, claims, and measurement levels
- Task suites, scenario tests, simulators, and shadow environments
- Outcome, process, safety, cost, and intervention measures
- Variance, confidence, contamination, and distribution shift
- Regression gates and adversarial testing

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to construct an evaluation plan that connects each reported metric to a specific system claim.
